title: Cross-thread InvalidOperationException when the splash screen is closed on a startup error
author: Piero-93
body_snippet:
## Description
When an error occurs during startup while the WPF splash screen is showing, the app crashes with a cross-thread `InvalidOperationException` that **masks the real error**.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Make startup connection loading fail (e.g. the configured connections file does not exist, such as `C:\Temp\confCons.xml`).
2. Launch mRemoteNG.

(Also reproducible on the FIPS-policy warning path in `CompatibilityChecker`.)
